claims.evidence: Witness photos show an industrial sewing machine head with a visible needle/presser foot area and stitch plate/bed; no evidence of zigzag/multi-pattern features in the reported views.

risks.risk: Not actually working (won’t power on, won’t stitch, or inconsistent feed).
risks.proof: A short test video: power on, needle moving, fabric feed, and a straight-stitch seam result.

risks.risk: Drive/belt/pulleys issue (belt slipping, cracked belt, worn pulleys, noisy motor/drive).
risks.proof: Close-up clip of the belt/pulleys while running (showing smooth motion) plus a photo of belt condition (no cracks/fraying).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as belt/drive may need replacement or service.

risks.risk: Needle/presser foot/feed dog wear or damage (bent needle, worn feed teeth, missing/incorrect foot).
risks.proof: Close photos of needle tip, presser foot underside, and feed dog teeth; plus a stitching test showing even feed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as parts may be worn and may require replacement.

risks.risk: Rust, internal oil leaks, or damage under the head/table affecting reliability.
risks.proof: Photos of underside/base and inside head area (where accessible) showing no rust/oil leaks; wipe test showing dry surfaces.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may have hidden wear/damage.

risks.risk: Missing accessories needed to operate (foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, attachments).
risks.proof: Inventory photos/clip showing included items: foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, and any attachments.

risks.risk: Wrong voltage/plug or incompatible with Abuja power setup.
risks.proof: Photo of the machine’s rating plate/label (voltage/Hz) and the plug type; show it powering on with correct adapter/transformer if needed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may require electrical adaptation.

risks.risk: Brand identification uncertainty (brand appears as 'emel' but exact model/serial not readable).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating plate/serial/model number area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without model-specific value (worst-case generic industrial).

proof_requests: Test run video showing power on and straight stitching on fabric (start-to-finish seam).
Close-up photos of belt/pulleys and a clip of them running smoothly.
Close photos of needle, presser foot, and feed dog (teeth condition).
Photos of underside/base and inside head area (rust/oil leak check).
Photos of included accessories: foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, and any attachments.
Clear photo of the rating plate/voltage label and the plug type.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as an industrial straight-stitch machine, but key value drivers (working condition, drive/belt health, and included accessories/voltage) are not shown. Without at least a test run and accessory/voltage confirmation, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
